name: in-field-progress-circle
description: In field progress circles indicate progress for loading states within form fields and input areas.

staticColor.description: Static color for use on colored backgrounds. White draws a light ring, black a dark one. Unset is the regular ring.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Circular ring behind the progress arc.

anatomy.name: fill
anatomy.description: Arc showing progress; spins when indeterminate. Not drawn at 0%.

anatomyReview.notes: Matches Figma S2 Web (.In-field progress circle, Subcomponents page): two ellipses, a full-ring track and a partial-arc fill. Figma names both ellipses 'Track'; the fill is the second one. No container: the track is the outermost drawn element. There is no determinate form: React Spectrum draws it as an indeterminate ProgressCircle in ComboBox and Picker, so the recipe draws one fixed arc frame and the component declares no value options.
